title: English for Life and Work: Proficient

program.section_heading: English for Life and Work: Proficient
outcomes: Compose resumes, summaries, reports, evaluations, business letters, e-mails, memos, instructions, and multi-paragraph compositions using academic vocabulary and accurate use of grammar at the low-advanced level.

Possess accurate understanding of, apply, and use most English grammatical structures to meet most needs and demands in a variety of life and workplace situations using vocabulary at the low-advanced level.
Read, respond, summarize, and interpret low-advanced reading passages and authentic documentation in varying modes and formats using a wide range of academic reading skills and reading strategies.
Respond confidently, fluently, and accurately to a wide variety of social, personal, and professional situations at the low-advanced level.

notes: The catalog prints this noncredit Certificate of Competency (CDCP) in units (0.0 Units) and states no hours, so measure is 'units' and the totals hold the printed 0.
Course codes are printed without a space (ELW905, ELW906); they match closed-list ELW 905 and ELW 906.

Award Instructions say students must complete courses culminating in the successful completion of ELW 906, which suggests ELW 905 may be satisfied by progression rather than taken directly. Reviewer should check.
The catalog labels the award 'Certificate of Competency'; the request names it 'Noncredit program'.
The source URL slug references 'fall-2025' although the catalog year is 2026-2027.
